title: Ball hits a ball-marker
question: If your ball accidentally hits a ball-marker on the green and is deflected to a new spot, what should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it comes to rest with no penalty.
Replace your ball and the marker.
Move the ball back to its original spot and continue.
Add one penalty stroke and replay the putt.

explanation: If your ball strikes a ball-marker on the green, you play the ball from where it ends up, with no penalty.
imagePrompt: A teenage golfer on the putting green observing their ball after it accidentally strikes a ball-marker left by another player.
imageAlt: Teenager's ball on green deflected by a ball-marker.
